questions.subject: Physics
questions.stem: In Schedule 10 Question 1: For an organ pipe of length L closed at one end, what is the frequency ratio of the first three consecutive harmonic overtones?
questions.solution: A pipe closed at one end supports standing waves with a node at closed end and antinode at open end, producing only odd harmonics: f_n = (2n-1) * v / (4L).

questions.stem: In Schedule 10 Question 36: A sound wave of frequency f = 3700 Hz propagates in air with speed v = 340 m/s. Find the wavelength in meters (rounded to 3 decimals).
questions.solution: Wavelength lambda = v / f = 340 / 3700 = 0.092 m.
